condition: Reading an Arrow IPC stream or file whose dictionary-encoded field leaves out DictionaryEncoding.indexType (the spec allows this and says the indices default to int32) raises "OSError: Unexpected null field DictionaryEncoding.indexType" instead of using int32.
workaround: Have the writer (for example apache-arrow JS) always set indexType for dictionary fields; pyarrow has no reader-side workaround at this version.
